mapper.select: SELECT service_key, service_name, segment_cost, updated_by, updated_at FROM ai_service_pricing ORDER BY service_key
SELECT service_key, service_name, segment_cost, updated_by, updated_at FROM ai_service_pricing WHERE service_key = #{serviceKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_service_pricing (service_key, service_name, segment_cost, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{serviceKey}, #{serviceName}, #{segmentCost}, #{updatedBy}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE segment_cost = VALUES(segment_cost), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = NOW()
INSERT INTO pricing_change_log (service_key, old_cost, new_cost, admin_id, changed_at) VALUES (#{serviceKey}, #{oldCost}, #{newCost}, #{adminId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, service_key, old_cost, new_cost, admin_id, changed_at FROM pricing_change_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
